name: Vision-in-Text Challenge (ViTC)
description: ViTC is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to recognize and interpret prompts that cannot be solely understood through semantics, specifically focusing on ASCII art-based inputs. It assesses LLMs' robustness against novel jailbreak attacks leveraging ASCII art to bypass safety measures.
reputation: A recent safety benchmark that has attracted interest for probing ASCII-art-based jailbreak robustness, but it is still niche and not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Introduces ArtPrompt jailbreak attack exploiting LLMs' poor ASCII art recognition; evaluates five SOTA LLMs; code available on GitHub.
